{{Quotation|game|Built shortly after the Sunspears withdrew from Dynastic service, this arena serves as a place for Sunspear heroes and new inductess to hone their fighting abilities.}}
[[Sunspear Arena (outpost)|Sunspear Arena]] is the staging area for characters wishing to participate in the [[PvP]] fights taking place in the [[Sunspear Arena]].

==Getting there==
Characters must first talk to [[Yahir]] the [[arena guard]]  in [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan|Kamadan]] to unlock this location.

==Exits==
*[[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] (south)
